subject: Kickoff: MAP and evaluation timeline for NovaPulse
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novapulse.ai>, Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Kickoff: MAP and evaluation timeline for NovaPulse

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. As discussed, I wanted to get a short mutual action plan (MAP) in motion so we have a shared set of milestones and owners for the evaluation and procurement path. Draft goals here: 

- Objective: Validate Redwood’s inference stack for NovaPulse production workloads (gen-quality, 99th pctl latency, and cost per 1M tokens)
- Target close: contract signed by week of 2026-06-29 (end of Q2)
- Key milestones:
  1) MAP kickoff + stakeholder alignment — week of 2026-04-27
  2) Evaluation plan (test corpus, success criteria) — complete by 2026-05-10
  3) Trial runs / performance tests — 2026-05-11 to 2026-06-05
  4) Business review + procurement review — week of 2026-06-08
  5) Final negotiation & SOW — 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-26

Action items for this email:
- Elena / Tom: please confirm the primary champion and technical reviewer we should add to the MAP (I list Tom tentatively as exec sponsor below)
- Everyone: confirm the target close date above or propose an alternate cadence
- Optional: 30-min MAP kickoff next week to align on success criteria and test dataset (proposal: Tue 2026-04-27 10:00 PT)

I attached a one-page MAP template (NovaPulse_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our standard SOW template to speed alignment. Once you confirm attendees and the kickoff slot, I’ll send a calendar invitation and circulate a short agenda.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: NovaPulse_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP template), SOW-template.docx
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novapulse.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@novapulse.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 09:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP and evaluation timeline for NovaPulse

Sean — thanks for the clear layout. We’re aligned on the objective and the proposed milestones, and the target close of end of June looks good from a business standpoint. A few quick notes: 

- Champion: I will be the executive champion on the NovaPulse side.
- Technical reviewers: please add Aisha Khan (Director, MLOps) and Tom will coordinate infra-level access. Aisha is a must for the performance targets.
- Procurement: I’ve looped in procurement@novapulse.ai for early visibility on any licensing terms.

The proposed kickoff is fine — Tue 27 Apr 10:00 PT works for me and Tom. If you want to include a short pre-read, please highlight the evaluation success criteria and the test-corpus ask.

Looking forward —
Elena Ruiz
VP Product | NovaPulse AI
elena.ruiz@novapulse.ai

Thanks Elena — glad to have you as champion. Couple of internal asks from our side before the kickoff: 

- Can you and Aisha share a small representative prompt set (10–15 queries) and a sample response expectation doc? We’ll use that for quality gating.
- We recommend adding a latency / throughput target row in the MAP (99th pctl latency goal + tokens/sec throughput) — I’ve attached a short evaluation checklist that teams commonly complete during the MAP phase.
- If procurement will want redlines or specific SLAs, procurement@novapulse.ai, please flag anything we should pre-populate in the SOW.

Sean — I’ll draft the evaluation section (test plan + success criteria) and attach it to the MAP. Ben, can you be on the kickoff to cover pricing cadence and any pilot credit guidance?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
